paper.title_en: Combination of ATLAS and CMS Searches for Higgs Boson Pair Production at <math display="inline"><mrow><msqrt><mrow><mi>s</mi></mrow></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><mi>TeV</mi></mrow></math>
paper.abstract_en: This Letter presents a combination of searches for Higgs boson pair (<math display="inline"><mi>H</mi><mi>H</mi></math>) production performed by the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations using proton-proton collision datasets recorded at <math display="inline"><msqrt><mi>s</mi></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>13</mn><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><mi>TeV</mi></math> during the Large Hadron Collider Run 2, corresponding to integrated luminosities ranging between 126 and <math display="inline"><mn>140</mn><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><msup><mi>fb</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The upper limit at the 95% confidence level on the total <math display="inline"><mi>H</mi><mi>H</mi></math> signal strength, defined as the ratio of the measured cross section to the standard model (SM) prediction, corresponds to 2.5, with an expected value of 1.7 (2.8) assuming the absence (presence) of the SM <math display="inline"><mi>H</mi><mi>H</mi></math> signal. The strength of the <math display="inline"><mi>H</mi><mi>H</mi></math> signal is measured to be <math display="inline"><msubsup><mn>0.8</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>0.7</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>0.9</mn></mrow></msubsup></math> relative to the SM prediction. The observed significance is found to be 1.1 standard deviations whereas 1.3 are expected for the SM <math display="inline"><mi>H</mi><mi>H</mi></math> signal. Constraints are set on the Higgs boson trilinear self-coupling and on the couplings of two Higgs bosons to two vector bosons, both normalized to the SM predictions and denoted as <math display="inline"><msub><mi>κ</mi><mi>λ</mi></msub></math> and <math display="inline"><msub><mi>κ</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>V</mi></mrow></msub></math>, respectively. The observed individual constraints at the 95% confidence level are <math display="inline"><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>0.71</mn><mo><</mo><msub><mrow><mi>κ</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>λ</mi></mrow></msub><mo><</mo><mn>6.1</mn></mrow></math> and <math display="inline"><mn>0.73</mn><mo><</mo><msub><mi>κ</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>V</mi></mrow></msub><mo><</mo><mn>1.3</mn></math>, while the expected constraints assuming the presence of the SM <math display="inline"><mi>H</mi><mi>H</mi></math> signal are <math display="inline"><mo>-</mo><mn>1.3</mn><mo><</mo><msub><mi>κ</mi><mi>λ</mi></msub><mo><</mo><mn>6.7</mn></math> and <math display="inline"><mn>0.66</mn><mo><</mo><msub><mi>κ</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>V</mi></mrow></msub><mo><</mo><mn>1.4</mn></math>.
